email.subject: Quick fix for Cool Breeze's site
email.body:
Marcus,

Looked at Cool Breeze Pros' site. Two things are likely costing you jobs: it's not mobile-friendly, so anyone searching for HVAC help on their phone (most of Harbor Falls) has a hard time even reading it, and there's no booking option, so people who are ready to schedule now have to call during business hours or bounce to a competitor who makes it easy.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's losing you calls. Worth a look?

Alex
Northlight Web
